description: This file defines a FastAPI application with two POST endpoints: one for uploading raw file bytes and another for uploading files as UploadFile objects. It imports FastAPI and related modules, creates an app instance, and exposes two routes.

methods.name: create_file(file: bytes = File(description="A file read as bytes"))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /files/ to accept raw bytes of a file.

methods.name: create_upload_file( file: UploadFile = File(description="A file read as UploadFile"), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /uploadfile/ to accept an uploaded file as UploadFile.
